Sharpscale Coast is the southwestern shore of the Forbidden Reach mainland. The beach has been overrun by the Irontide Raiders from the Tempest Cove. The coast is bordered by the Aerie Chasm and Skyfox Den to the north and northeast, the Frosted Spine to the east, the Broken Seaboard to the southeast, Talon's Watch to the southwest, and Morqut Islet and Morqut Village to the west. Raiders on the beach include brinecasters, bulwarks, crackshots, crushers, cutthroats and squawkers. Additionally, the named hermit crab Karkinus the Capsizer spawns at the south end of the beach, and amberfur slyvern, hardback skitterers, and scavenging pinchers wander around.

Shield Hill is an ancient vrykul burial ground located at the southernmost point of Howling Fjord. At some point just prior to the war against the Lich King, under the leadership of Jonah Sterling, the Northsea Freebooters pirates stole a few artifacts from the graves of Shield Hill, which brought the kvaldir to Northrend's shores, as they disturbed the spirits of the dead. Among the stolen artifacts were The Frozen Heart of Isuldof, The Staff of Storm's Fury, The Shield of the Aesirites and The Ancient Armor of the Kvaldir. __NOTOC__ Shek'zeer Bladesworn are mantid warriors of the Shek'zeer found at the Clutches of Shek'zeer in the Dread Wastes. They are sometimes seen patrolling on amber scorpids. Their Amber Blades are some of the finest weapons of the empire, and they carry them with pride.

__NOTOC__ Shek'zeer Swarmborn are the newly hatched of the mantid empire, found at the Clutches of Shek'zeer in the Dread Wastes, being tended to by the Shek'zeer Clutch-Keepers. Normally, they would begin devouring each other when born until only the strongest remained, but these ones are imbued with fear from the sha energy they've been saturated in. Instead, their births are rushed so that they can swarm the Serpent's Spine as soon as possible, and they are driven by terror, rather than instinct. The Klaxxi see this as an abomination.

A Shield spike refers to an item crafted by blacksmiths to a shield that deals damage every time a hit is blocked. Shield spikes occupy the enchantment slot and will overwrite any existing enchantment. They can also be attached to a shield of any level and used by a shield-wielding character of any level.

The Shifting Mire is the central bulk of the Swamp of Sorrows west of the Pool of Tears. Here you will find Young Sawtooth Crocolisks, Sorrow Spinners, Swamp Jaguars and Lost Ones. The name Shifting comes from a mysterious force causes the extremely fine silt on the ground to collect and move on its own accord, travelling as if alive. Anchorite Avuun says that the origin of the force is positive energy. See Secrets of the Mire.
Shifting Cloak is crafted by Leatherworkers with a skill level of 300. pattern: Shifting Cloak is a rare drop from Knot Thimblejack's Cache.

The Shimmering Flats was a large stretch of salt flats at the southeastern end of Thousand Needles, on the border with Tanaris. The area was an open expanse devoid of any vegetation and home to various varieties of, among other things, basilisks, scorpids, turtles, and vultures. The area was a dried lakebed, as evidenced by the wrecked sailing vessel in the northern part. The flatness of the area made it especially desirable for goblins and gnomes, who had set up the Mirage Raceway and constantly competed against each other to see who could build the fastest racing machine. Shieldmaster Daeun is a draenei located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.

Shiny Pet Charm is a quest reward from Battle Pet Roundup / Scrappin', which are started by Lio the Lioness and Serr'ah (respectively) at a Level 1 / 2 Menagerie in the Garrison, and from the daily pet battle quests on . At a Level 3 Menagerie, the daily quest is exchanged for Mastering the Menagerie that rewards you with a Big Bag of Pet Supplies, containing Pet Charms. Fel-Touched Pet Supplies also contain a few charms. The bag comes from defeating the Tanaan Jungle legendary pets.
Shima Islebreeze is a pandaren innkeeper and food and drink vendor located inside the Lion's Den at Lion's Watch in Tanaan Jungle.

The Shield of the Naaru is a shard of the ata'mal crystal. It was in possession of Velen after the fall of Shattrath and is presumably still in his possession. It is either the orange shard or the indigo shard, as they are the only colors of the ata'mal crystal left unaccounted for.
Shimmering Shards drop and are mined from many Cataclysm elementals.
Shieldtronic Shield is created with Engineering (1); taught by Draenor Engineering (item). It can also be obtained from the Blingtron 5000 Gift Package rewarded from Blingtron 5000 (quest).
Shiny Pet Charmer is an achievement earned by holding 500 Shiny Pet Charms in your bags from the garrison.
Shimmering Gauntlets is a token that is used to create an hands-slot armor suitable for a character's armor class.

Shimmer is a mage class talent. It is a replacement for Blink that has two charges and can be cast while casting, but increases the cooldown by 10 seconds and does not clear stuns or roots. It is an exclusive choice node with Ice Floes.
Ship Blueprint: Battleship is the blueprint used to learn how to construct Battleships at
Shield of the Sea Queen is one of the artifacts used by restoration shamans in World of Warcraft: Legion. It is automatically equipped in the off hand when wielding Sharas'dal, Scepter of Tides.
__NOTOC__ Ship: The Awakener is sold by Dawn-Seeker Krisek in Tanaan Jungle and Apexis traders in Ashran for . You must also be with the Order of the Awakened.
The Shifting Taladite Ring is crafted with Jewelcrafting (1); taught by Recipe: Shifting Taladite Ring.
Shield of Virtue is a Protection paladin PvP talent, available at Level 20. It allows Avenger's Shield to interrupt and silence all enemies within 8 yards of the paladin.
Delicate Roc Feather is used to create Rocfeather Skyhorn Kite.

Shieldmaidens (or shield-maidens) are female vrykul warriors. Most of them serve the Valkyra and the Valarjar through them, though others are found in the ranks of the Winterskorn clan or the Hyldnir.

Shieldmaiden Iounn is a vrykul ghost located in the Field of Fallen Kings in Stormheim. In The Favored of Odyn, she is described as a mighty warrior who waged battles across Azeroth. She aided Ashildir during her quest to become the queen of the Valkyra by rescuing her when the Ashildir was defeated by Helya's forces. As she did that she too was injured and passed away with a smile. She once more joined Ashildir as a defender of the Valarjar Valkyra.
Shindrell's Note is provided as an objective for Kayneth Stillwind (quest).
Shimmering Manaspines are dragon turtles located at the Shal'dorei Terrace in the Nighthold.
Shimmering Hourglass is a reward from the Class Hall mission Oculus Preparations: Eternos.

Shimmering Elixir of Suspension is provided by Ernest Carlisle for Borrowed Time (quest). He created it with Shimmering Pollen (quest item), Spotted Gloomcap, and Rotwood Root in order to treat Shinfel Blightsworn's doom curse.
Shimmering Whorl can be found in the waters at the Black Market in Dalaran.

Shieldbreaker Murdonn was a fel-crazed vrykul who broke through the outer defenses of Dalaran, and made it all the way to Krasus' Landing. He was accompanied by a felbat named Fangs. They were taken down by the champions of the Class Orders.
The Shimmering Quicksilver Drape is a quest reward from Drustfall.
__NOTOC__ Shimmering Oleanders are lashers located in Val'sharah.
Shiny Objects were never made available, and ultimately replaced by Ecto-dimensional Proton Beams.
Shiny Rings are Pick Pocketed from humanoids in the Broken Isles.
__NOTOC__ Shimmering Shallows is a location in Stormsong Valley. The naga are pressing an attack on Seabreeze Village from here, led by Binder Sa'thress.
Shieldbearer Phalanxes are paladins located in the Sanctum of Light.
Shinfel's Staff of Torment is a reward from the Class Hall mission Shinfel's Staff of Torment.
Shifting Cosmic Sliver drops from Kil'jaeden in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Shieldwall Footmen are humans located in A Little Patience, Krasarang Wilds, and some are found dead on the Isle of Thunder during the attempt to bring Heavy Explosives to Silver Covenant forces.
Looting this item will cause you to shimmer for five minutes.
Shieldwall Peasants are humans located outside Lion's Landing in the Krasarang Wilds.
Shiny Benyani is a skeletal troll located underwater between the western and central docks in the Port of Zem'lan in Vol'dun, seemingly skinning a dead Stoneshell Sea Turtle.

Three Ships appeared docked at the Alliance Naval Base. They were stolen by the Horde led by Thrall to get to Kalimdor. Later, the ships of Lordaeron Navy that Arthas Menethil brought to Northrend were burned by mercenaries he hired.
Shimi the Slick is a goblin innkeeper located at the Mugambala in Zuldazar. She sells food and drinks.
Shieldbearers of Zul are skeletal trolls located in Zuldazar and in Atal'Dazar.
Shiny Sea Serpent Scales are bought from the Crimson Angerfish at Biel'aran Ridge in the Shimmering Expanse.
Shielded Azerite Tank is an Alliance war machine located at Norwington Estate in Tiragarde Sound during the Horde War Campaign. One the shield is disabled, it becomes attackable.
Shimmerfin are carp located in the rivers of Zuldazar and Dazar'alor.
The Shieldbearer's Oiled Cloak was a quest reward from To Weather the Storm.
The Shimeji clan is a clan of fungarians. The only known members, the spawnbrothers Genjo and Hanzin, can be found at the Dive Bar off the coast of Zuldazar.
__NOTOC__ Shieldwall Vindicators are draenei located at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.
__NOTOC__ Shieldwall Stormcallers are draenei located in Krasarang Wilds.
Shieldwall Divers are humans, night elves, and gnomes initially planned to appear during Runnin' On Empty.
Shieldwall Gryphon Riders are Wildhammer dwarves riding gryphons at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.
__NOTOC__ Shieldwall Huntresses are night elves located in Krasarang Wilds.
Shieldwall Menders are draenei, humans, dwarves, and worgen planned to appear in Krasarang Wilds.
Shieldwall Saboteurs are humans, dwarves, night elves, and gnomes.
__NOTOC__ Shimmerspine Harvesters are murlocs located in Kelp'thar Forest.
The Shimmering Eel Skin drops from the Shimmerscale Eel in the Abyssal Pool in Nazjatar.
Shimmering Remnants are arcane elementals located in the Blood Coast in Nazmir during Faction Assaults.
